answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 40 tokens; its fingerprint of task mix, timing and counterparties grows like a vine. Audits match prints against sybil clusters on a marble ledger; a cloned print freezes and slashes the escrow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 tokens, and 95% are caught in 20 epochs, since copies lack variety. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep an umber-sealed print, and earn steadily.
